faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does residential interior design in Karnal cover?

Full-home planning, kitchens, wardrobes, bathrooms, ceilings, lighting, flooring, furniture and décor for independent houses, kothis and apartments.

Can you design one floor now and another later?

Yes. We can plan the whole house and complete one floor first, so the later floors follow the same style.

Do you include a puja room and guest rooms?

Yes. Puja rooms, guest bedrooms and spaces for visiting family are planned as part of the home, not left for later.

Why start residential interior design before construction ends?

Planning early lets us fix electrical points, plumbing and furniture sizes before plastering and flooring, which avoids breaking finished work.
